creativeThesis: Follow a small administrative object into a building-scale consequence; reveal the dangerous disposal choice through a connected sequence.
viewerExperience: Start with fire and a receipt, rewind to a matching record, descend into the furnace, follow smoke to the floor and emerge into aftermath.
emotionalTarget: Incredulity, comprehension, then sober recognition of consequence.
visualThesis: Original continuous illustrated scene-space in midnight plum, pale stone linework and ember orange. Tallies have tactile grain; architectural sections visibly schematic. Camera moves between macro wood and large chamber, rather than repeated titled cards.

decisions.treatment: Original deterministic SVG illustrated environments, split-tally macro, carts and chamber/furnace cutaway.
decisions.rationale: Shows linked physical choices with stable continuity; no authentic archival footage claim.

decisions.treatment: Midnight plum/coral theatrical reconstruction with broad spatial illustrations; architectural linework, grain detail and restrained ember light.
decisions.rationale: Darkness is chosen for ember/stone contrast and historical nighttime consequence, not topic style or forced alternation.

decisions.treatment: Local Kokoro af_heart at 0.97; clear intrigued opening, deliberate warnings and survival.
decisions.rationale: Existing primary narrator; no unnecessary audition or material deviation.

decisions.treatment: Large pale Manrope phrases left aligned, no backing card, fixed glyphs and four-frame opacity ramps.
decisions.rationale: Clear speech-first reconstruction; precise qualifiers stay readable below illustrated action. Font continuity deliberately serves readability.

decisions.treatment: Voice with sparse original low-level furnace rumble and wood ticks; quiet split-record explanation; no music.
decisions.rationale: Sound supports material/setting without invented eyewitness recording; no sensational blast.

decisions.treatment: Measured phrases with short holds at split, floor breakthrough and survival; length follows actual speech.
decisions.rationale: Cause and chronology need breathing room; no monetization padding.

decisions.treatment: Begin with fire-bearing old-Palace silhouette and notched stick as the opening causal claim is spoken.
decisions.rationale: Immediate relationship earns curiosity; rewind resolves it.

decisions.treatment: Four bound provisional playback profiles; critical illustrations, words and persistent reconstruction label sampled inside surviving insets.
decisions.rationale: Local QA never grants mobile/native safety; no release preparation before master approval.

portfolioReview.selectionRationale: Four latest exact approved masters by decision entry, rendered sheets inspected and all available direction records read; no popularity filter.
portfolioReview.proposedFeedImpression: Narrative illustrated environments and scene traversal, with wood-to-building scale reversal; controlled linework and embers rather than isolated recurring object cards.
portfolioReview.toolingBiasCheck: Reusable SVG and caption code can bias another center-stage explainer. Materially different archive collage and tabletop/flowchart alternatives explored; choose spatial narrative because it explains disposal consequences, not because renderer is available.
